title: The Punch That Boils Water
description:
The peacock mantis shrimp throws the fastest punch in the animal kingdom — fast enough to superheat the water around it. Here's how it works, and why its eyes are just as wild as its claw.

#shorts #sciencefacts #oceananimals

scenes.text: This shrimp punches so fast, it makes the water around it boil.
The peacock mantis shrimp swings its claw with the acceleration of a bullet leaving a gun barrel.
It moves so fast it superheats the water for a fraction of a second, creating a flash of light and a shockwave called cavitation.
That shockwave alone can stun or kill prey, even if the claw itself misses.
Its eyes are just as strange. It sees with sixteen types of color receptors, compared to the three humans have.
Follow for more facts about the ocean that sound made up but aren't.
